deploybot: Rollout rbld/inference:20260324-hotfix triggered elevated 5xx in eu-west1 (embeddings). Auto-PAUSED. Logs: https://internal.logs/ingest/1719740000 :warning:

elaine: Ack. Is this the kv-cache edge case again?

mike: Looks like the quant kernel on embed-shard-7. Reproduced in staging.

sre-oncall: 15m snapshot: +1.9% 5xx in eu-west1, p95 +22ms. Isolated to shard-7.

ops-lead: Options: full rollback, regional rollback, or targeted patch+canary. Recommend regional rollback + traffic evac then patch shard.

elaine: Agreed. Execute regional rollback for eu-west1 and divert embed traffic.

sre-oncall: Running: rbctl traffic shift --service=embeddings --from=eu-west1 --to=global-fallback --percentage=100 --confirm

deploybot: Action logged: traffic-shift executed by sre-oncall at 2026-03-24T02:40:00Z.

mike: Pushing micro-patch (disable quant kernel for shard-7). ETA ~20m. Will request 5% manual canary after push.

elaine: Approve 5% canary once patch is pushed. Abort criteria: >0.5% error increase sustained 10m -> rollback to rbld/inference:20260320-stable.

sre-oncall: Alerting configured. Dash: https://dashboards/internal/embeds-eu-west1

mike: Patch pushed: rbld/inference:20260324-hotfix.1. Pin request submitted.

deploybot: Pin command recorded: deploybot pin --image=rbld/inference:20260324-hotfix.1 --scope=eu-west1 --percentage=5 --reason="shard-7 kernel patch"

ops-lead: +1 for 5% canary. Proceed.

sre-oncall: Canary steady at 5% for 18m, no new 5xxs. Holding to 30m then ramp.

elaine: Good work. Sam will post a short advisory for support and product.
